At 656 PM EDT, severe thunderstorms were located along a line from
over Furman to near Tarboro. These storms were stationary.

HAZARD...60 mph wind gusts and small hail.

SOURCE...Radar indicated.

IMPACT...Expect damage to roofs, siding, and trees.

Locations impacted include...
Estill, Furman, Scotia, Pineland, Robertville, Tarboro, Garnett,
Grays, Gillisonville and Lena.

This includes I-95 in South Carolina between mile markers 28 and 31.
